test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ie_events (id UInt64, start UInt64, end UInt64, val_hi UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE ie_points (id UInt64, ts UInt64, val UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ie_events SELECT number, intHash64(number) % 100000000, intHash64(number) % 100000000 + 10 + number % 100, 1000000 + intHash64(number + 3) % 1000000 FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
INSERT INTO ie_points SELECT number, intHash64(number + 7) % 100000000, intHash64(number + 13) % 1000000 FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM ie_points p JOIN ie_events e ON p.ts >= e.start AND p.ts <= e.end FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM ie_points p JOIN ie_events e ON p.ts < e.start AND p.val > e.val_hi FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM ie_points p LEFT ANTI JOIN ie_events e ON p.ts >= e.start AND p.ts <= e.end FORMAT Null
